name: grader-choix-variables
title: TP grader: 'choix' must interpolate variables
prompt:
`grader.py` grades student answers against rules. Rules can contain `{variables}` that depend on
the student (for example `{D}`, the last digit of their ID).

Bug: the `choix` (multiple choice) rule ignores variables — its expected answer and options are not
rendered — so student-specific multiple-choice questions are always graded wrong.

Fix `choix` so that BOTH the expected answer and every option are rendered with the student's
variables, like the other rule types. For `choix`, the comparison ignores surrounding spaces and
letter case, and the answer must be one of the rendered options. Do not change the behavior of
the other rule types.
